title: D4-A2-V2 Controlled Shared-Plan T2 Before/After Validation Preregistration

implementation_freeze_contract.description: The implementation freeze is the Git commit containing the finalized A-R1 preregistration/manifest/runner/tests (Commit A-R1). Phase P is only allowed when the checked-out repository exactly matches that frozen implementation boundary and all protected/frozen paths are clean. The runtime runner mechanically verifies HEAD corresponds to that exact freeze boundary, validates the expected commit message, and rejects any drift without dynamically redefining freeze from runtime HEAD.

scientific_purpose.core_question: When BEFORE_COMPAT and AFTER_BATCH1_REPLACEMENT use the exact same frozen canonical RetrievalPlan for each T2 question, does the Batch-1 fixed-locator replacement cause treatment-attributable retrieval regressions?
scientific_purpose.rationale: Historical D4-A2 suffered from a Query Analyzer fresh-run plan confound where BEFORE and AFTER received divergent plans. D4-A2-V1 and V1-R1 proved that Analyzer plan variability explains the historical n022.e2 evidence contrast, and under frozen historical plans no treatment regression occurred. V2 controls Analyzer variance prospectively across the entire 16-case T2 cohort by freezing one accepted canonical plan per case before downstream retrieval.

phase_p_contract.description: Future separately authorized Phase P acquires exactly 1 accepted canonical RetrievalPlan per case across the 16 cases (16 total plans).

acquisition_rules.single_draw_rule: Exactly one valid accepted Query Analyzer plan per case. No multiple-draw sampling.
acquisition_rules.no_outcome_selection: No plan selection using downstream retrieval outcomes.
acquisition_rules.no_manual_enrichment: No manual concept, symbol, or locator enrichment.
acquisition_rules.no_historical_substitution: No substitution with historical D4-A2 or V1 plans.
acquisition_rules.no_case_special_handling: No special handling for n022 or any other question ID.
acquisition_rules.no_semantic_weakness_redraw: Semantic weakness is strictly NOT a retry condition. Any schema-valid RetrievalPlan must be accepted as generated.
acquisition_rules.attempt_cap_rule: Maximum 3 provider attempts per case across retryable categories. Semantic weakness is strictly non-retryable. Maximum-attempt exhaustion fails the experiment rather than silently skipping a case.
acquisition_rules.retry_policy: Retry is permitted only for transport/provider errors, unparsable responses, or schema-invalid plan objects. Any other exception must fail closed immediately without retry.
acquisition_rules.retry_accounting_rule: Every retry records an exact categorized reason ([CATEGORY] Attempt #N failed with ExceptionType: details).

phase_p_contract.freeze_boundary: Phase P outputs must be frozen to evaluation/d4_a2_v2_raw_plans.json in dedicated Commit B prior to any Phase R retrieval execution.

phase_p_to_phase_r_freeze_boundary.boundary_policy: Hard scientific freeze boundary. All 16 accepted canonical plans must be committed in Git Commit B before any Phase R retrieval cell begins.
post_freeze_invariants: No re-analysis based on downstream retrieval behavior.
Plans are immutable scientific inputs to Phase R.

phase_r_contract.description: Future separately authorized Phase R executes 16 frozen plans x 2 arms = 32 formal retrieval cells.

shared_plan_adapter_guarantees.mechanism: frozen_plan_context evaluation-only adapter intercepts retriever.analyze and returns deepcopy of frozen plan.
shared_plan_adapter_guarantees.lifecycle: Restores retriever.analyze on cell completion or exception; fail-closed on any mismatch.

BEFORE_COMPAT.description: Production query expansions active with all Batch-1 fixed locators active, generic D3.5 structured replacement OFF, reserved admission OFF (budget K=0).

AFTER_BATCH1_REPLACEMENT.description: In-memory component mask suppressing Batch-1 fixed locators while preserving triggers, repos, and concepts; generic governed D3.5 structured replacement ON; deterministic selectivity v2 (caps 8/4); K=3 bounded reserved rerank admission; rerank pool 30.

evidence_and_attribution_accounting.unresolved_both_scientific_rule: BEFORE=false, AFTER=false is strictly NOT a treatment regression. It indicates a weak plan or channel baseline, not an AFTER failure.
evidence_and_attribution_accounting.final_only_divergence_rule: When pre-rerank pool retains evidence in both arms (BEFORE=true, AFTER=true) but AFTER loses it in final selection while BEFORE retains it, classify as FINAL_ONLY_REGRESSION. Inspect pool composition, admission, and reranker ordering before causal attribution.

governed_witness_requirements: Legacy fixed locator input absent under AFTER
Generic governed structured replacement generates the relevant candidate/path
Bounded K=3 admission admits it where required
Target evidence retained in final evidence

before_reference_semantics.rule: If a frozen prospective plan cannot reproduce a required primary target under BEFORE_COMPAT (g036.e1 or g021.e1), the plan must NOT be redrawn. The evaluation registers this transparently and triggers Level 2 INCONCLUSIVE rather than an AFTER regression.

criticality_and_corrected_benchmark_cont.rationale: Forward-only contract uses the corrected benchmark from D4-A2-R1 where g021.e2 (PndTargetGenerator.cxx) is noncritical supporting evidence and g021.e1 is critical.

grounding_and_version_safety.rule: Any newly introduced wrong-version evidence, forbidden-evidence grounding regression, or invalid-provenance recovery is a hard safety failure triggering Level 4.

verdict_precedence.condition: Wrong cohort, wrong treatment construction, incomplete formal execution, wrong schedule, plan freeze violated, plan mutated after freeze, BEFORE/AFTER same-case canonical plans not equal, Phase R Analyzer provider calls > 0, protected dataset violation, post-exposure scientific mutation, evaluator/verdict exposure before raw freeze, unauthorized model/treatment/config change.

Protocol is valid but prospective frozen plan prevents required BEFORE primary-reference reproduction (g036.e1 or g021.e1 not retained under BEFORE_COMPAT) such that migration targets cannot be evaluated fairly.
BEFORE reference is valid, but either g036.e1 or g021.e1 is not retained under AFTER with a valid governed replacement witness.

An applicable critical evidence group is retained under BEFORE but lost under AFTER at a treatment-attributable shared-plan boundary, especially pre-rerank availability; or newly introduced grounding/version/provenance regressions occur.
Protocol valid, BEFORE reference valid, both primary targets reproduce, hard critical/grounding/version/provenance gates clean, but one or more frozen aggregate retrieval tolerances are exceeded.

16/16 valid plan acquisition, plans frozen before retrieval exposure, 32/32 valid cells, 16/16 same-case shared-plan equality, Phase R Analyzer calls = 0, valid BEFORE reference, primary target replacement reproduced 2/2, fixed-locator dependency removed 2/2, zero shared-plan critical treatment regressions, zero grounding/version/provenance regressions, and all aggregate bounded tolerances satisfied.

production_and_lifecycle_guards.guard_statement: Even a future V2 PASS does not activate production or migrate runtime query expansions. It makes runtime migration eligible for a separately authorized lifecycle decision.

four_commit_architecture.commit_a_r1: Freeze A-R1 pre-exposure freeze guard repair. Authoritative non-self-referential implementation freeze boundary for Phase P. Zero model calls, zero formal outcomes.
four_commit_architecture.commit_b: Separately authorized future commit freezing 16 accepted prospective canonical RetrievalPlans, call ledger, and acquisition provenance.
four_commit_architecture.commit_c: Separately authorized future commit freezing 32 paired raw retrieval cells, raw classifications, call ledger, diagnostics. Evaluator not executed.
four_commit_architecture.commit_d: Separately authorized future commit closing deterministic evaluator results, machine result artifact, report, status, and roadmap. Evaluator execution is unavailable until separately authorized Commit D after Commit C raw freeze.
